transport_rule.download: single-stream local download with retry/resume; do not issue remote random-range analytical queries
transport_rule.header_gate: after download, read only the decompressed TSV header and require the exact frozen projected columns before any support aggregation
transport_rule.row_support_after_header_pass: run the already-frozen v0.4 aggregate support query locally; do not persist raw edge identities

terminal_rule: If the frozen TSV fallback cannot be downloaded, fails checksum/header validation, or cannot complete the support aggregation, stop the primary joint interaction route; no third source or serialization is allowed.
